title: 855. Buddy Strings

examples.explanation: Exchanging the two characters turns "ab" into "ba".
No swap of distinct positions keeps them equal.
Swapping the two equal letters leaves "aa".

hints: If the lengths differ, success is impossible without even checking letters.
When the strings are already identical, look for any repeated character that allows a harmless swap.
Otherwise there must be exactly two mismatching spots, and the letters must cross-match.
